name: shoot-1690
about: 1690 preloaded with 8 in its ALLIANCE ZONE in TELEOP: the turret swings round on its motor against its swivel chain, the wheel's velocity loop and the hood come to the shot, the indexer (floor, belts, vertical kicker, feeder wheels) feeds and the carriage agitates; the FUEL go into the HUB; then it drives out past the zone line, intakes, and passes back (M3c).
